title: Prospective Observational Study Based on a Cohort of Geriatric Patients With Hip Fracture Treated in the Centers Belonging to the GIOG Group
official: Prospective Observational Study Based on a Cohort of Geriatric Patients With Hip Fracture Treated in the Centers Belonging to the GIOG Group
summary: The study aims to collect the clinical activity and management data of the Orthogeriatrics and Orthopedics Units participating in the study on a continuous and long-term basis. By collecting clinical data and comparing the performance of the various centers, the study aims to guide the participating centers towards the principles of good clinical practice in orthogeriatrics.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Fracture of the femur, regardless of the cause
* Age ≥ 65 years
* Willingness to participate in the study by the patient or a relative / caregiver, if the patient is unable to understand and is not "competent" at the time of the evaluation.
* Able to speak the Italian language

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
